finding.finding: Two authoritative snapshots conflict on S20 equipment state: fault at observed minute 0, then cleared at minute 5.

The only resolved actionable fault is the conflicting equipment state at S20; evidence does not establish whether equipment repair is needed. Equipment repair EQ-S20 exists and equipment-skilled crews and roads are available, but the conflict must be clarified. No evidence makes any action unsafe or impossible, so no action is deferred.

finding.finding: V20/S20 (Veyangoda) is the only service approved as critical, with weight 5; all other services have standard weight 1. The two authoritative Veyangoda snapshots conflict: one reports cells out of service, and a later snapshot reports the alarm cleared and KPIs normal. Recency alone does not resolve the conflict, so current outage status is unknown. The Bandaragama complaint and planned Piliyandala interruption do not establish a current asset outage. No evidence supports changing approved priorities.
